Business Context
Click any field to edit Saved
What the product does
Mobile-first event management platform — ticketing, attendee check-in, real-time analytics, and post-event reporting for mid-market organizers.
Who the users are
Event organizers (primary), attendees (end-users), venue staff (operations). ~12K MAO, ~400K attendees/mo.
Business model
SaaS subscription + per-ticket fee. Three tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise). Revenue from Pro tier. Enterprise on annual contracts.
Client priorities
1) Mobile parity with web  2) Reduce onboarding drop-off (38%)  3) Push notifications before June  4) WCAG 2.1 AA for enterprise
